subject.title: [Bug]: tools/sandbox: MEDIA_MAX_BYTES (5 MB) is hardcoded and not user-configurable

question: Should OpenClaw expose or reuse a bounded operator-configurable cap for generic media-store and sandbox staging, or keep the 5 MiB generic cap and approve only narrow channel/document exceptions?
rationale: The source-level problem is clear, but the broad fix changes resource-limit configuration/default behavior that affects sandbox media exposure, disk usage, and message delivery failure modes.

options.title: Approve a bounded shared cap
options.body: Use one documented bounded cap contract across media store, sandbox staging, chat preflight, and reply-media defaults with schema/help/docs and regression coverage.

options.title: Land narrow exceptions only
options.body: Keep the generic 5 MiB cap and approve focused exceptions only where downstream channel limits and real behavior proof justify them.

options.title: Keep the current cap intentionally
options.body: Document the 5 MiB generic staging cap as a safety default and close the broader configurability request after maintainer confirmation.

recommendation.title: Approve a bounded shared cap
recommendation.body: Use one documented bounded cap contract across media store, sandbox staging, chat preflight, and reply-media defaults with schema/help/docs and regression coverage.

likelyOwner.reason: This decision spans core media, sandbox staging, and security/default policy, where history points most strongly to steipete for routing.
